eventTitle: Demo Robotics Q1 FY2026 Earnings Call (invented)

data.text: Good afternoon and welcome to the Demo Robotics first quarter call. Thank you for joining.
Thank you. Demand for our warehouse robots stayed strong this quarter. We opened a second factory in Porto to shorten delivery times for European customers.
Revenue grew 18% year over year to $1.2 billion. Gross margin was 41%, down one point, because the new factory is still ramping. For the second quarter we expect revenue of about $1.3 billion.
Thank you. How long until the Porto factory reaches full output?
We assume it reaches full output by the end of the year, and margin should recover as it does.
